name: KINGSEMI Co., Ltd.
summary: KINGSEMI Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sales, and service provision of semiconductor fabrication equipment in China and internationally. The company offers coater and developer, clustered coater and developer, automatic coater and developer, semi-automatic machine, and spray coater; single-wafer scrubber; single-wafer wet stripper; single-wafer etcher; temporary bonding tool and laser debonding tool; and fully automatic SiC scribe and break machine. Its products are used in semiconductor production, packaging, MEMS, LED, OLED, 3D-IC TSV, PV, and other fields. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shenyang, China.
